morphology.pattern_note: 未核实为马来语普通词。若指人名 Diaz，应大写；不能将 di- 当作马来语被动前缀，也不能据拼写确定该人名的实际读音。

senses.zh_definition: 可能对应专名 Diaz（人名或姓氏）；现有资料不足以确认小写 diaz 是具有独立释义的标准马来语普通词。
senses.en_definition: An unresolved form potentially representing the proper name Diaz; no independent standard Malay common-word meaning has been verified.
senses.ms_definition: Bentuk yang belum disahkan sebagai kata umum bahasa Melayu; mungkin merujuk kepada nama khas Diaz.
senses.nuances: 本项仅提供专名识别与拼写说明，不把人名用例视为普通词获正式收录的证据。以下为说明性组合，非已核实的高频搭配。马来文学术文献确有 Bartholomew Diaz 这一人名写法：[UKM 学术论文](https://www.ukm.my/jatma/wp-content/uploads/makalah/IMAN_12_Mei_2013_-_11.pdf)。

collocations.en: the spelling of the name Diaz

dual_scenarios.ms: Bentuk 'diaz' dalam senarai itu perlu disemak untuk menentukan sama ada bentuk tersebut merujuk kepada nama khas Diaz.
dual_scenarios.zh: 须核查清单中的 diaz，以确定它是否指专名 Diaz。
dual_scenarios.en: The form 'diaz' in the list requires checking to establish whether it refers to the proper name Diaz.

dual_scenarios.ms_spoken: Kat senarai tu tertulis 'diaz'; nama orang ke?
dual_scenarios.ms_standard: Dalam senarai itu tertulis 'diaz'; adakah itu nama orang?
dual_scenarios.zh: 名单上写着 diaz，是人名吗？
dual_scenarios.en: The list says 'diaz'. Is that someone's name?

etymology.historical_story: Names can enter Malay texts without becoming Malay vocabulary. A Malay academic article uses Bartholomew Diaz when discussing European voyages, illustrating this distinction. The supplied lowercase form does not identify a particular person or establish a dictionary meaning. Its pronunciation, naming history and Jawi representation therefore remain unresolved rather than reconstructed from spelling alone.
etymology.cognitive_memory_aid: 先辨名字，再背意思：见到 diaz，先核查是否应写作 Diaz；不要把 di- 拆成被动前缀。
